title: Language Generation Models Can Cause Harm: So What Can We Do About It? An Actionable Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying and categorizing various detection and mitigation strategies across the model development lifecycle, including data filtration, counter-speech data augmentation, model fine-tuning (e.g., RLHF), and decoding-time interventions.

Reviewing targeted interventions such as augmenting training datasets with synthetically generated data in dialogue systems and improving coreference mechanisms to mitigate bias in machine translation.

Discussing the exclusion of non-standard dialects by examining how toxicity detectors disproportionately flag African-American English (AAE) as toxic, and surveying techniques for adapting language models to low-resource language varieties.
